rows.note: This is the all-purpose rendering when you mean that you like or are fond of someone or something.

example.english: I am fond of this movie.
example.jyutping: ngo5 zung1 ji3 ni1 tou3 hei3

rows.note: Use this for a person who is caring and affectionate, rather than simply liking something.

example.english: They are fond of children and very caring.
example.jyutping: keoi5 deoi3 sai3 lou6 hou2 jau5 oi3 sam1
